'''Rodno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] who served as a guide for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadril]]. The Rebels helped reunite Rodno with his lover, [[Deerna]].

==Biography==
As a head of science at [[Kadril]] [[Dal Quirz]] was assisted by Rodno, her young assistant. Rodno hoped to live with [[Deerna]], but because she heard from [[Nociv]], she found Rodno unworthy as a partner. All hope was based on the strength of his experimental invention: the [[Vibro-crystal]].

Rodno learned [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and after Quirz recalled that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wanted to collect [[Kunda]], Rodno, Han and Luke went to the Nocivs where Kunda was located.

Rodno warned the Nocivs for an attack by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. In this attack [[Mdel]] came to life and the elder was buried on the [[Hom Mounds]]. Deerna found Rodno still unworthy, but during a last attack by Father with the [[Pacifog]], Rodno saved Deerna's life.

Meanwhile, Leia, Del Quirz and Chewbacca discovered that Rodno's [[Vibro-crystal]] proved to be a great success and even protected from the Pacifog of Father. Rodno recovered from his injuries and Deerna found him a worthy partner.

==Behind the scenes==
Rodno appeared in the comic strip ''[[Planet of Kadril]]'' by [[Russ Helm]] and [[Alfredo Alcala]]. Helm, a drummer, based the character's name on American radio DJ Rodney Bingenheimer.
